messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Under Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008, who bears the cost of carrying out the periodic verifications of the lifting devices in the IGEA list?

response.text: Ai sensi dell'articolo 71 del Decreto Legislativo 81/2008, chi sostiene il costo delle verifiche periodiche degli apparecchi di sollevamento presenti nell'elenco IGEA?
